title: Fairy Oracle Wheel
description: A surreal steampunk scene features two fairies in front of a massive dark mechanical wheel with glowing orange spiral energy at its center. One fairy in pink takes a selfie while another in green stands beside her, with a giant green praying mantis perched on top of the wheel.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with two detailed fairies, one in pink and black checkered dress taking a selfie with a pink smartphone, the other fairy in green beside her. A giant green praying mantis with translucent wings sits atop a massive dark mechanical wheel with glowing orange spiral vortex in the center. The wheel has glowing pink circular portals showing castles. Below are an open book titled 'Stacia Oracle' with red wax seal, pink pillows, lantern, and floating gears against a cloudy sky with distant castles and colorful nebula.
